references.text: Continuation of the instructions concerning uncleanness and meat from the peace offering, describing the consequences for one who eats sacrificial meat while unclean.
Laws regarding what makes a person unclean through contact, expanding on the concept of uncleanness mentioned in the verse.
Detailed laws about various forms of uncleanness that would prevent a person from eating holy meat.
Rules for priests concerning uncleanness and eating holy offerings, parallel to the instructions about sacrificial meat.
Laws regarding uncleanness through contact with dead bodies and the required cleansing process.
Instructions on slaughtering and eating meat, including the prohibition against eating blood.
The prophet Haggai asks the priests questions about the transfer of holiness and uncleanness through contact.
